name: blog/authors-list
label: List authors
description: List authors of the Blog app, filtered, ordered and paged like GET /authors.

name: blog/authors-get
label: Get one of authors
description: Get one authors row of the Blog app by id.

name: blog/authors-create
label: Create in authors
description: Create one authors row in the Blog app; the input is the row.

name: blog/authors-update
label: Update in authors
description: Update one authors row of the Blog app: the given fields of `patch` change, the rest stay. Send the `_rev` of your read to refuse the update if the row changed since.

name: blog/authors-delete
label: Delete from authors
description: Delete one authors row of the Blog app; returns the deleted row.

name: blog/authors-revisions
label: Revisions of authors
description: List the saved revisions of one authors row of the Blog app, newest first.

name: blog/authors-stage
label: Stage a change to authors
description: Save changes to one authors row of the Blog app as its staged version: the given fields of `patch` are staged, and the live row stays as it is until the staged version is promoted.

name: blog/authors-staged-get
label: Staged version of authors
description: Read the staged version of one authors row of the Blog app: the row as it would be once promoted, and the fields that are staged.

name: blog/authors-staged-compare
label: Compare staged and live authors
description: List the staged fields of one authors row of the Blog app whose value differs from the live row, with both values.

name: blog/authors-staged-promote
label: Promote staged authors
description: Make the staged version of one authors row of the Blog app live, as an update of the row. With `at` (a future time) the promote is scheduled instead; `at: null` cancels a scheduled promote.

name: blog/authors-staged-discard
label: Discard staged authors
description: Discard the staged version of one authors row of the Blog app. The live row is untouched and the discarded version stays in the row's revisions.

name: blog/authors-staged-preview
label: Preview link for staged authors
description: Create a signed link to the staged version of one authors row of the Blog app. It works without signing in until it expires (`ttl` seconds, an hour by default) or the staged version is promoted or discarded.
